name: Show Hidden Channels
description: Shows the channels you are not allowed to open, with their real names (it asks Discord not to hide them, like Equicord) or, where Discord still hides the name, a name made from a template. Tap one for an info sheet (topic, dates, who is let in). Allow or block servers, channels, categories, kinds of channel and words, with a self-check.
author: MarkLong0467 (https://github.com/MarkLong0467 "GitHub")
contributors: ShowHiddenChannels for Vencord, Equicord and Aliucord (the idea; code written from scratch for Valenced)
Found with the decompiled Discord app by Wumpus-Central (discord-mobile-datamining)
